text: Yes, the JRC map supports the 2023 tree-cover loss claim. The evidence shows a 0.7-hectare loss within the asset, confirmed by Hansen/UMD data and corroborated by the JRC 2020 forest reference map, which agrees with 100% of the event area. The loss occurred in a mixed context, with planted forest (Eucalyptus species) identified in the impacted zone. While the JRC map and other sources validate the loss, they do not specify the cause (e.g., harvesting, fire) or its legality. The evidence meets the minimum event area threshold (0.5 ha) and is supported by high-resolution spatial data.
